name: Duel to The Holes
source:
Welcome to The Hole, where the only thing bigger than the trouble is... well, let's just say the locals have a few extra tricks up their sleeves - and their pants.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280860/Duel_to_The_Holes/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到“深洞镇”——在这里，唯一比麻烦本身还要巨大的，嘛……这么说吧，镇上的居民不止袖子里藏着几手绝活，裤裆里也颇有“过人之处”。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280860/Duel_to_The_Holes/]Steam[/url]]
